item.title: Falcon 9 Stage Crashes Into Moon, Leaving Crater
item.description: SpaceX’s Falcon 9 second stage hit the Moon, forming a crater. KARI’s Danuri orbiter captured images, while telescopes detected sodium and lithium plumes.
